## Pro-Tier Support Issues — Q3 2026

The most common support issues for Pro-tier accounts this quarter:

| Category | Ticket Count |
|---|---|
| Integration | 284 |
| Performance | 231 |
| Billing | 198 |
| API | 167 |
| Data quality | 143 |

**Key observations:**

Integration issues are the top driver — connector failures with third-party ERP and CRM systems. Performance complaints spiked mid-quarter, likely correlating with a platform infrastructure update. Billing questions remain elevated as Pro-tier accounts approach their usage caps approaching end of quarter.

turns.input: Pro-tier support ticket categories quarterly breakdown

turns.summary: Querying Pro-tier tickets with quarter date filter
turns.input: FROM precision-support-tickets | WHERE account_tier == "Pro" AND created_at >= "2026-07-01" | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY category | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 10

turns.summary: Getting category breakdown with month granularity
turns.input: FROM precision-support-tickets | WHERE account_tier == "Pro" AND created_at >= "2026-07-01" | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY category, DATE_TRUNC(1 month, created_at) | SORT count DESC
